title: Basil Pesto Gnocchi Bake with Asparagus, Mushrooms, Tomato & Parmesan

steps.text: Place pesto, oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut crosswise into 2-inch pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Wash, dry, and add tomatoes to the baking sheets with the asparagus.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the baking sheets along with the mushrooms and gnocchi. Drizzle with the pesto oil, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and gnocchi is golden, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide gnocchi bake between plates or bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
